description: The technology directory: the apps and vendors detected on tracked brands' sites (Shopify, Klaviyo, Recharge…), ranked by how many brands use each and how those brands are doing. Pass `slug` for one technology's adopter stats and its category peers. To list the brands or ads behind a technology, pass its name as `technologies` to sightglass_find_ads or sightglass_find_site_pages. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

category.description: App category as the fingerprinter labels it, e.g. email-sms

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

slug.description: One technology's slug from an earlier result: returns its adopter stats and peers instead of the directory.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_technologies
title: Find technologies
